items.title: Heroes of Life
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Do you like superheroes? Well what better than to be an every day superhero that gives their lives to helping others. With this pack of skins you can make it happen, have fun with your friends playing a superhero and saving lives.

items.title: Skyblock | 5 Dimensions

items.description:
Skyblock, and beyond. Experience Skyblock Overworld, Nether, and End. We also bring you the Mystical Forest and Cloud City Dimension of Skyblock. Go through the portals and discover all-new worlds filled with more Skyblock.

+ Skyblock Overworld, Nether and End
+ Mystical Forest and Cloud City
+ New pets, blocks, items and mobs

We wish you luck in your skyblock adventure.

items.description: Update your style with the newest apparel from the Minecraft x UNIQLO UT and UTme! Collections. Coming soon, Minecraft UT Kid’s collection available at UNIQLO stores and UNIQLO online store worldwide, plus UTme! Custom Designs for Adults and Kids available at select UNIQLO stores.

items.creator: G2Crafted

Deep in the remote jungles of Japan, you will find a secret society of ninja animals that were given the task to protect the rainforest, and the animals within, from the outside world. Now you too can protect as one of these elite ninjas by roleplaying with your friends. Become one with the elephant, rhino, zebra or more!

items.title: Trendy Waves 2021
items.creator: Team Visionary

Trendy waves are awakening the city! Welcome to this busy city where everyone wants to be the trendiest. Meet new free spirits who can't wait to talk to you! Make new friends and become the most popular teen while you're going out and try new fashion styles! This pack is for you!

items.title: Lily's Island
items.creator: Humblebright Studio
items.description:
A cute resource management simulation game which takes mining, farming, and fishing into a whole new level! Help out little animals to gather resources and build their island before winter arrives. 

+ Single-player adventure mode
+ Custom furniture pieces
+ Custom crops and resources
+16 lovable NPCs
+ Custom quests
+ Hidden secrets and challenges
+ 5 custom soundtracks

items.title: Original One Block Challenge 2.0
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Experience the true one block challenge. Break the one block and a new block will take its place. Use these blocks to build the world around you.
- Bonus chests
- Mob spawns
- Skyblock style gameplay
- 3 different game modes
- Playable in French, English, German, and 5 other languages

One block is skyblock taken to the extreme!
items.changelog:
Progression doubled (2048 cycles, 32 phases) with new blocks, items, and mobs. 
New Legacy Mode offers classic gameplay. 
Plus, more islands in Island Mode!

items.title: Millionaire Desert Mansion

Congrats on buying your dream millionaire desert mansion! We've already moved your furniture, car, helicopter, and jet skis onto your new property. Escape city life and decorate your new world! Enjoy living in your new mansion and fly your helicopter into the sky!

- Modern millionaire mansion
- Furniture with easy to use tools
- Car, and helicopter
- Rich life roleplay
